title: Safety gate interlock
goal: A safety reviewer can trace the dual-channel gate permissive, reset, guard lock, and safe-state output.

rubric.must: GateChannelA, GateChannelB, GuardLockFeedback, and ResetPB are visibly in series to the SafePermit set coil.
Separate normally closed GateChannelA and GateChannelB contacts visibly reset SafePermit on separate rungs.
Both gate-channel contacts visibly appear in series to GuardLockSolenoid.
SafePermit and GuardLockFeedback visibly drive SafeStateOutput.
An EStop contact visibly drives a SafePermit reset coil.
Normally closed gate-channel contacts form visible parallel paths to GateOpenLamp.

ideal.notes: Independently hand-composed reference after visual-eval/exemplars/ladder/ideal.svg (sha256 72319743d0eb). Vision-reviewed rendered SVG against source and exemplar, including labels, connections and symbol placement. Measured spacious rung bands and consistent AB contact, coil and reset-bracket symbols. All rungs and branch membership preserved.
